responsibility: This header declares the mc-boot runtime interface for copying the current time into a caller-provided character buffer. It exposes the single TimeString_GetTimeString procedure, defining the fixed-array API for formatted time text returned from the underlying C wrapper layer.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the declaration half of the GTimeString pair, exposing TimeString_GetTimeString to clients, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GTimeString.cc contains the concrete copy-from-wrapc implementation.
